task: Independent hostile audit of the Dang et al. 2025 skull-wave PDE, speed reduction, alpha fit, and BAPN readout

claims.statement: SI Eqs. 29-30 omit the factor 2 stated immediately before them; SI Eq. 32 does not follow from Eq. 30 or the standard KPP formula, has the wrong growth-difference sign and missing D in the speed term, and is dimensionally inconsistent with Eq. 27.
claims.assumptions: SI notation and units; scalar reduction defined by the source.
claims.source_anchors: Supplement pp. 12-14; local equation screenshots and extracted text noted in sources/NOTES.md.
claims.novelty_boundary: A source correction, not a new biological mechanism or regenerative capability.
claims.falsifier: A primary author erratum or a documented alternative nondimensional convention that restores all three printed equations and units.
claims.next_gate: Obtain a source-authored corrected derivation and intended units for alpha; no external author contact was made.

claims.statement: At the homogeneous mesenchymal edge, linearization of the full source PDE decouples the fraction perturbation as psi_t = D psi_xx + [(kB-kA)|rhoA + alpha DeltaE] psi. The associated linear spreading speed is 2 sqrt(D r); the full nonlinear coupled front speed remains unclassified.
claims.assumptions: Perturbations about rho=rhoA^c, phi=v=0; constant leading-edge coefficients; source constitutive equations.
claims.novelty_boundary: Linearized PDE derivation is source-specific; KPP speed theory is established prior art. No tissue-level theorem is claimed.
claims.falsifier: A correction to the PDE closure or a linearization showing first-order velocity/density terms in the fraction perturbation under the stated homogeneous edge.
claims.next_gate: Measure homogeneous-edge growth, D, and material-frame drift on a live front.

claims.statement: The released seed has exponential tail q0=0.005333 um^-1, well below q*=0.061637 um^-1 under notebook numeric parameters. The scalar KPP shallow-tail comparator is 10.7649 um/h, while the steep-tail minimum is 1.8491 um/h; the finite scalar replay gives 10.694 um/h over 0-8 h. The full source PDE is not covered by the scalar selection theorem.
claims.assumptions: Scalar constant-density, zero-advection logistic reduction; semi-infinite front-like interpretation for the asymptotic formula; finite-domain computation separately labeled.
claims.novelty_boundary: Initial-tail-dependent Fisher-KPP selection is established. This source-specific application is not a biological speed law.
claims.falsifier: A corrected seed profile or unit/rate parameter that makes the measured exponent q0 steep relative to sqrt(r/D).
claims.next_gate: Measure live in-vivo tail exponent and run a matched held-out profile condition.

claims.statement: Within the scalar shallow-tail model c=Dq+(g+alpha DeltaE)/q, a single c does not identify alpha if q is unmeasured; explicit positive shallow (q,alpha) pairs reproduce c=10.808225 um/h.
claims.assumptions: The scalar KPP reduction and the initial-tail speed relation; source-code numerical stress convention.
claims.novelty_boundary: An algebraic identifiability limit under a named reduced model; not evidence the biological tissue obeys it.
claims.falsifier: Independently known q, or a full-model observable that identifies alpha despite q variation.
claims.next_gate: Acquire q independently and fit/test across a held-out stiffness-gradient condition.

claims.statement: The active notebook estimator computes absolute signed spatial-sum differences, not an L1 profile shape residual. On the published output it reports 0.03728287; pointwise L1 at the chosen shift is 0.41495017. Both objectives select shift 3 on this one output.
claims.assumptions: Literal active Mathematica notebook expression; saved source phi matrix; same candidate grid.
claims.novelty_boundary: Metric misdescription is confirmed; the selected velocity is unchanged under L1 for this output.
claims.falsifier: A different active notebook branch or data matrix than the pinned release.
claims.next_gate: Use a pointwise norm and report mesh/time/window sensitivity if profile translation is intended.

claims.statement: Notebook converts Pa to internal stress by 12.96 but leaves alpha unchanged; Table S1 omits alpha units. Table viscosity is 10^4 Pa s, notebook uses 10^3 Pa s.
claims.assumptions: Source code and Table S1 values copied as published.
claims.source_anchors: Tissue_model_simulator.nb lines 159-200; Supplement Table S1 p.14.
claims.novelty_boundary: Unit meaning of alpha cannot be resolved from available sources; viscosity mismatch has negligible baseline speed effect in this replay.
claims.falsifier: An explicit source-authored declaration of the numeric alpha's internal stress unit and parameter conversion.
claims.next_gate: Resolve alpha units before refitting or comparing physical parameter values.

claims.statement: BAPN data report stiffness, collagen-fiber, reporter-gradient, and endpoint bone-area changes, but no matched front-speed series or quantitative BAPN-parameterized PDE prediction. The endpoint area result is directionally consistent and does not validate the speed equation or alpha.
claims.assumptions: Primary article text and figure captions.
claims.novelty_boundary: A boundary on interpretation, not a claim against the reported biological area effect.
claims.falsifier: A source-reported matched BAPN speed time series and pre-specified quantitative intervention prediction not found in the inspected package.
claims.next_gate: Measure BAPN front speed and material-frame drift; predict it using BAPN-mapped tissue fields without refitting alpha.

costs.local_runtime: NumPy 2.5.3; full coupled replay <1 s, reduced scalar run <1 s; no SciPy
costs.data_inputs: Saved 201x101 rho/phi/V arrays, four ex-vivo interface time series, cell displacement/speed summaries, in-vivo size CSV
costs.mathematica: Unavailable; full PDE independently transcribed and matched against saved outputs
